capabilities: Show each view of an open .base file as a tab in the toolbar
Switch between views with one click or next/previous commands
Reorder views by dragging tabs onto each other
Set per-view tab visibility, color and size via context menu or Configure view
Restore the selected cell and scroll position when switching between same-type views
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.14.0+. Relies on Obsidian internals because there is no public API for the Bases toolbar, so a future Obsidian update may stop the tabs from showing; tab settings are stored inside the .base file and survive uninstall. Available in many languages, with untranslated ones falling back to English.
intentEvidence: See every view of an Obsidian base at a glance.
problem: In Obsidian, switching between views of a base requires opening the view menu each time; the plugin makes every view visible and switchable as a tab next to the result count.
summary: Shows a base's views as toolbar tabs with view type icons, letting you switch views in one click and set each tab's color, size and order.
